description: Price one quote with quote_id, or use items for several parts in one order. A bundle returns per-item totals before shipping, one shipping charge, the order total before tax and the estimated shipBy date when available. No checkout is created.

items.description: Parts to ship in one order. Use qty for repeated copies of the same quote, color and material. Do not mix items with top-level print fields.

material.description: "pla" (default) or "petg". PETG is made to order in black or white: we order the filament after you buy, which adds 3 to 5 business days, and the print price is 20% higher. Other materials (TPU, ABS, ASA and more) on request: ask in the designer chat and we reply with a price.

options.description: Optional add-ons for this print item.

cleanup.description: +$5. Supports removed and sharp edges deburred.

colorNote.description: Which parts get which color (required with extraColors).

fileCheck.description: +$5. We review the file for printability and fit before printing and email you if something looks off.

rush.description: +50% of the print price. Printed within 1 business day. Ships with the same USPS service.

quoteId.description: The quote_id returned by quote_file or quote_catalog_item.
